name: Advertised Lotteries on Housing Connect by Lottery
description:
This dataset contains one row for each advertised affordable housing lottery listed on New York City's Housing Connect platform, covering 1,789 lotteries. Each record includes the lottery's name and status (such as Tenant Selection, All Units Filled, Closed, or Active), whether it is a rental or owner development, and its start and end dates. It also captures the scale of each offering through building and unit counts, along with the number of studio, one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom units where available.

Income eligibility is recorded as counts of units within bands ranging from extremely low to middle income as percentages of Area Median Income, plus a small number of above-AMI units. The data also documents set-aside preferences for lottery mobility, vision and hearing, community board residents, municipal employees, NYCHA residents, and applicants aged 62 and over. Location details include borough, postcode, community board, and latitude/longitude coordinates, with some entries marked "Multiple"
